messages.content: hw do i finsh my homwork fast befor dinner

You want to finish your homework quickly before dinner. Start with the hardest subject while you are fresh, keep your phone away, and work in short bursts with a two-minute stretch between them. Check your answers once at the end.
how to rember all the formulas for sience exam

You're asking how to remember the formulas for a science exam. Write each formula on a small card with one worked example on the back. Test yourself with the cards every day, and say each formula aloud once before you sleep.
my techer gave me no marks for presentaion why
You want to know why your teacher gave no marks for your presentation. I can't know her reasons. Please ask her politely after class what the marking points were and what you can do better next time.
which tym is best 4 studdy morning or nite
You're asking whether morning or night is the best time to study. It depends on when you feel most awake. Try both for a week, notice when you remember more, and then keep a fixed time every day.
wil the board paper be tough this yr

You're asking whether this year's board paper will be tough. I can't know that, and nobody can before it is set. Practise with last year's papers and ask your teacher which chapters carry the most marks.
how can i read fastr and still understnd
You want to read faster and still understand. Read the headings first, then read the text without saying every word in your head. After each page, tell yourself the main point in one sentence.
wat is a fraction explan simple
You want a simple explanation of a fraction. A fraction is a part of a whole thing. If a roti is cut into four equal pieces and you eat one, you have eaten one quarter, written as 1/4.
i am afraid of speking in class

You're saying you feel afraid of speaking in class. Many students feel this way. Begin by answering one easy question each day, prepare your sentence in your head first, and speak slowly. It gets easier with practice.
can u help me wit my esay on rainy seson

You want help with an essay on the rainy season. Begin with how the sky looks before rain, then write about the smell of wet earth, children playing, and farmers' joy. End with how the season helps nature.
how to lern english wordz everyday
You're asking how to learn English words every day. Learn only five new words a day and write one sentence with each. Keep a small notebook and read the old words again every weekend.
my frend say i will fail do u think so
You're worried because your friend says you will fail. I can't know that, and your friend can't either. Make a simple study plan, ask your teacher about weak topics, and judge by your own work.
how long shud i study in one sitng
You want to know how long to study in one sitting. About 30 to 45 minutes works well for most students. Then take a short break of five to ten minutes, walk a little, and drink water.
wher is the nearst libary open on sundy
You want to know where the nearest library is open on Sunday. I can't see your area or their timings. Please call the library, check the notice board at its gate, or ask your teacher.
hw to start a letter to princpal for leev

You're asking how to start a leave letter to the principal. Begin with the date, then write To, The Principal, and the school name. Next write Subject: Leave application, and then Respected Sir or Madam.
i get nervus befor exam wat to do

You're saying you get nervous before exams. Prepare a little each day so the last night is calm, sleep well, and breathe slowly for a minute before the paper starts. If the worry stays strong, talk to a teacher or parent.
why sky is blu
You want to know why the sky is blue. Sunlight has many colours, and the air scatters blue light more than the others. That scattered blue reaches your eyes from every direction.
is there trik to memorise tabels

You're asking if there is a trick to memorise tables. Yes, find patterns. In the table of nine, the digits of every answer add up to nine. Also say the table in a rhythm, like a song, and practise it daily.
wat subjcts shud i take after 10th

You're asking which subjects to take after the tenth class. I can't choose for you, because it depends on your interests and marks. Talk to your teachers and parents, and meet the school's guidance counsellor if there is one.
how to underlin books propely

You want to know how to underline a book properly. Underline only the key words, not whole lines. Use one colour, and write a short note in the margin next to important points so you can revise quickly.
wat if i forgt my admit card
You're asking what to do if you forget your admit card. Tell your school or exam centre staff right away, since they know the rules there. Next time, put the card in your bag the night before.
how to mak frends in new school
You want to make friends in a new school. Smile, say hello, and ask a classmate a simple question like which book they are reading. Sit with different people at lunch, and join a club or game.
my mind wanderz wen i study hlp
You're saying your mind wanders when you study. Sit at a clean desk, keep only one book open, and set a timer for 25 minutes. When a random thought comes, jot it down and return to the page.
wat is differnce between area and perimiter
You want to know the difference between area and perimeter. Perimeter is the distance around the edge of a shape. Area is the space inside it, like the floor of a room.
tell me my result of unit tst
You're asking for the result of your unit test. I can't see your marks or school records. Please ask your class teacher, or check your report card or the school notice board.
how do i say sorry in english propper way
You're asking how to say sorry properly in English. You can say, I'm sorry for being late, or I apologise for my mistake. Add what you will do next, like, It won't happen again.
i dont undrstand algebra at all

You're saying you don't understand algebra at all. Think of a letter like x as a box holding a hidden number. If x + 3 = 7, you ask what number plus 3 makes 7. The answer is 4. Practise a few like this.
can i wair slippers to schol
You want to know if you can wear slippers to school. I can't know your school's rules. Please read the school diary or ask your class teacher what footwear is allowed.
how many hrs shud i sleep during exams

You're asking how many hours to sleep during exams. Most school students need about eight to ten hours a night, and exam time is no different. Sleep helps your memory keep what you studied, so keep a steady bedtime instead of staying up late.
how to learn a muzic instrument at home

You want to learn a musical instrument at home. Practise a little every day, even 15 minutes, rather than a long session once a week. Start with simple notes, go slowly, and learn the right finger positions from a teacher or a video lesson.
wat is a pargraph
You want to know what a paragraph is. A paragraph is a group of sentences about one idea. It starts on a new line, and the first sentence usually tells the main point.
how to make notes from textbok
You're asking how to make notes from a textbook. Read a section first, then close the book and write the main points in your own words. Use short lines, headings, and a small diagram where it helps.
wich pen is best for exm
You're asking which pen is best for an exam. I can't say one brand is best. Pick a smooth pen that doesn't smudge, that feels comfortable, and carry two or three spare ones.
wat is photosyntesis in easy word
You want photosynthesis in easy words. Plants make their own food using sunlight, water from the soil, and carbon dioxide from the air. They give out oxygen while doing this.
my bench partner copys my answers wat do i do
You're saying your bench partner copies your answers. Tell him kindly that you want to work on your own, and cover your page. If it continues, tell your teacher, who can help sort it out.
how to improv my handwritng
You want to improve your handwriting. Write slowly, keep letters the same size, and leave a small gap between words. Practise one neat page every day for a few weeks.
what questins will come in the english paper
You're asking what questions will come in the English paper. I can't know the paper in advance. Look at the syllabus and old papers, and ask your teacher which types of questions usually appear.
is studing with frends good or bad

You're asking if studying with friends is good or bad. It's good if you quiz each other and explain topics, and bad if you mostly chat. Pick one or two serious friends and set a topic before you begin.
how to chose a good story book for kid
You want to choose a good story book for a child. Pick one with large clear pictures and short sentences for young kids. Let the child choose between two or three, and read the first page together.
i lost my notbook how to get notes
You're asking how to get notes after losing your notebook. Ask a classmate to lend theirs and copy the pages. Also ask your teacher for the important points, and next time keep a spare copy.
how to solv word problm in maths

You want to solve word problems in maths. Read it twice, underline the numbers, and ask what is being asked. Then decide whether to add, subtract, multiply or divide, and check that your answer makes sense.
what is the fee for class 6 in my skool
You're asking for the fee for class 6 in your school. I can't see your school's fee list. Please check the school office, the admission notice, or the official website.
how to concentrat longer wthout phone
You want to concentrate longer without your phone. Keep it in another room while you study. Use a clock to track time, and promise yourself a short phone break after the work is done.
why do we hav exms at all
You're asking why we have exams at all. Exams let teachers and students see what has been learned and what needs more work. They also teach us to revise and to stay calm under pressure.
hw to pronunce 'comfortable'
You want to know how to pronounce comfortable. Most people say KUMF-ter-bul, with three beats. Listen to a dictionary's audio and repeat it a few times.
sop for colege wat to put in it

You're asking what to put in a statement of purpose for college. Say why you chose the course, what you have done so far, and what you hope to learn. Keep it honest and clear, and ask a teacher to read it.
my eyes pain wen i study much is it serius
You're saying your eyes hurt when you study a lot. I can't judge that. Please tell your parents and see an eye doctor. Meanwhile, rest your eyes every half hour and study in good light.
wen is the next holyday
You're asking when the next holiday is. I can't see your school calendar. Please check the school diary, the notice board, or ask your class teacher.
how to write 5 sentenses abt my best frend
You want to write five sentences about your best friend. Say the name, how you met, one thing you both enjoy, one thing you like about your friend, and why the friendship matters to you.
can u predct my marks in math
You're asking me to predict your marks in maths. I can't know that. Try a few past papers under time, see where you lose marks, and fix those topics.
wat is prime numbr
You'd like to know what a prime number is. A prime number can only be divided evenly by 1 and itself. Examples are 2, 3, 5, 7 and 11.
teacher said do project on watr cycle how start

Your teacher asked for a project on the water cycle, and you want to know how to start. Draw the cycle first: sun heats water, vapour rises, clouds form, rain falls. Then write one short line under each step.
i hav exam tomorow and not studid anythng

You have an exam tomorrow and haven't studied. Stay calm and pick the most important topics from your notes. Study them in short sessions, get a proper night's sleep, and eat something before the paper.
do u know my class teachr name
You're asking for your class teacher's name. I don't know it, because I can't see your school. Check your timetable, your school diary, or ask a classmate.
differnce betwen there and thier
You want the difference between there and their. There points to a place, like, Put it there. Their shows ownership, like, Their bags are on the bench.
how to focus wen sibling is makin noise
You want to focus while a sibling makes noise. Ask politely for a quiet hour and tell them when it ends. If it is still loud, move to another room or use a quiet corner, like the balcony.
y do i forgt wat i read
You're asking why you forget what you read. Often we read without stopping to think. After each page, close the book and say what you remember. Reviewing it the next day helps too.
how magnet work
You want to know how a magnet works. A magnet has an invisible field around it that pulls on some metals like iron. It has two ends, north and south. Opposite ends pull, and like ends push.
how to avoid silly mistaks in exam
You want to avoid silly mistakes in exams. Read each question twice, underline key words, and keep ten minutes at the end to check names, signs and units. Write neatly so you can read your own work.
how much marks needed for pass in 9th
You're asking how many marks are needed to pass in class nine. I don't know your board's rule. Please check the school's rule sheet or ask your class teacher.
wat is best way to lern coding for begginer

You're asking about the best way for a beginner to learn coding. Choose one simple language, like Python, and write tiny programs every day. Build small things you enjoy, like a quiz, and fix errors one at a time.
how to selct a good colege
You want to know how to select a good college. Check the courses, teachers, and how many students find jobs or higher studies. Visit if you can, talk to seniors, and read the official prospectus.
my mom say i spnd to long on homwork
You're saying your mom thinks you spend too long on homework. Try setting a timer for each subject and starting right away. If it still takes long, tell your teacher, who may help.
giv me gud starting line for story
You want a good first line for a story. Here is one: The night the lights went out, Meera heard a tiny knock from inside the cupboard.
wat do i do if i get blank in exam
You're asking what to do if your mind goes blank in an exam. Take a slow breath and move to a question you know well. Writing something easy first often brings the other answers back.
how to learn times tabels easly
You'd like an easy way to learn times tables. Learn them in small steps, one table a week. Say them aloud while walking or doing chores, and use skip counting, like 3, 6, 9, 12.
hw to ask teacher for doubt politly
You want to ask your teacher a doubt politely. Wait for a good moment and say, Ma'am, may I ask a question about this topic? Then explain what you understood and where you are stuck.
wat is a noun give exampel
You want to know what a noun is and see an example. A noun names a person, place, thing or idea. In the sentence, The girl ate an apple, girl and apple are nouns.
tym table for stuy after school
You want a timetable for studying after school. Rest and eat first for 30 minutes, then do homework, then revise one subject, then read for pleasure. Finish with a short look at tomorrow's classes.
wat are planets in solar sistem
You're asking which planets are in the solar system. There are eight: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune. They all go around the Sun.
will i get admisison in a gud college wit 80 percent
You're asking if 80 percent will get you into a good college. I can't know that, because each college has its own cut-off and it changes. Check the official websites for last year's cut-off marks.
how can i be class monitar
You want to become class monitor. Be on time, finish your work, help classmates, and be fair. Then tell your teacher politely that you would like the role.
how many books shud i read in a month
You're asking how many books to read in a month. There is no fixed number. One book a month is a good start, and you can read more if you enjoy it.
how to lern swimming
You want to learn swimming. Learn at a pool with a trained coach and a lifeguard, never alone. Start with floating and breathing, then kicking, and then arm strokes.
can u tel how to write a diary
You're asking how to write a diary. Write the date, then a few lines about what happened and how you felt. Be honest and keep it short, even three sentences a day is fine.
what is the date of my final exm
You want to know the date of your final exam. I can't see your school schedule. Look at the timetable your school gave you, or ask your class teacher.
how to do a book reprot
You want to know how to write a book report. Tell the title and author, then give a short summary of the story. Say what you liked, what you learned, and whether you would suggest it.
y zero cant be divid
You're asking why you can't divide by zero. Dividing means sharing into equal groups. You can't share something into zero groups, so no number can be the answer.
how to get scolarship for studys

You want to know how to get a scholarship for studies. I can't say which ones you can get. Ask your school office or counsellor, and look at the official government and college websites for the rules.
what is meaning of 'procrastinate'
You're asking what procrastinate means. It means to delay doing something that you should do. For example, Don't procrastinate, start your homework now.
iz it ok to study on bed
You want to know if it's okay to study in bed. It's better to sit at a desk, because the bed makes you sleepy. Keep the bed for rest and use a chair for books.
how to manage tym in 3 hour paper
You're asking how to manage time in a three-hour paper. Spend a minute reading all the questions, then divide your time by marks. Leave the hardest ones for last and keep a bit of time to check.
can i do bsc and job togther
You're asking if you can do a BSc and a job together. I can't say what your college allows. Ask the college office about attendance rules, and talk to your employer about your timings.
wat is the diffrence between weight and mass
You want the difference between weight and mass. Mass is how much matter an object has. Weight is how strongly gravity pulls on it, so it would be less on the Moon.
wat is the rule for mobile in school
You want to know the school rule for mobile phones. I can't see your school's rules. Please read the school diary or ask your teacher.
how to be good at drwing
You want to be good at drawing. Draw every day, even for ten minutes. Start with simple shapes, look closely at real things, and keep your old pages to see how you improve.
how to unnderstand poem
You want to know how to understand a poem. Read it slowly twice. Think about who is speaking and what feeling is there, and look up any word you don't know.
my parent want me to topp wat to do
You're saying your parents want you to top the class. Talk to them honestly about what feels possible. Show them your plan and effort, and ask them to support you instead of only counting marks.
how to revise in last week befor exam
You want to revise in the last week before the exam. Make a list of all topics, mark the weak ones, and give them more time. Do one old paper every other day and rest well.
is it ok to use calculater for homwork
You're asking if it's okay to use a calculator for homework. It depends on your teacher's rules. For practice sums, it is better to work by hand first and then check with a calculator if allowed.
how to talk in english witout fear
You want to speak English without fear. Speak a few sentences each day to a friend or a mirror, and don't worry about mistakes. Everyone makes them while learning.
mam is angry on me
You're saying your teacher is angry with you. I don't know why. Try speaking to her politely, say sorry if you made a mistake, and ask how to do better. If you feel unsafe, tell your parents.
how to writ good concluson
You're asking how to write a good conclusion. Restate your main point in new words, add a short closing thought, and don't bring a new idea in. Two or three sentences are enough.
wat is average
You want to know what average means. It is the sum of the numbers divided by how many there are. The average of 2, 4 and 6 is 12 divided by 3, which is 4.
how wil i no if i pass or not
You want to know how you will find out whether you pass. I can't see results. The school or board announces them, so watch for the official notice or ask your teacher.
what is gravty
You want to know what gravity is. Gravity is the pull that draws things toward each other. Earth's gravity pulls us down, which is why a dropped ball falls to the ground.
pls tell how to study wen lights go off
You want to know how to study when the power goes off. Use a torch or an emergency lamp and revise things you can say aloud, like tables or poems. Plan reading tasks for the lit hours.
how to learn chess for begineers
You're asking how a beginner can learn chess. Learn how each piece moves, then play slow games with a friend. Solve simple puzzles and think about what your opponent wants to do next.
wat is hall tickit
You want to know what a hall ticket is. It is a paper that lets you enter the exam hall. It has your name, roll number and exam centre, so keep it safe and carry it.
my sister's school have fest wen
You're asking when your sister's school fest is. I can't know that. Ask your sister, or check the school notice board or newsletter.
me new in school how i find class room
You're new in school and want to find your classroom. Ask a teacher or a senior student, and look at the room numbers and signs. Write your section and room on a small card to carry.
plz tel me tips 4 mcq tst
You want tips for a multiple-choice test. Read every option before picking, remove the clearly wrong ones first, and don't spend too long on one question. Come back to the hard ones at the end.
wat shud i eat befor studing
You're asking what to eat before studying. A light snack like fruit, nuts, or a bowl of curd is a good choice. Avoid very heavy or oily food, and drink water.
how i can inprove my vocabulry
You want to improve your vocabulary. Read a little every day and note new words with their meanings. Use each new word in a sentence of your own within a week.
wat is a haiku
You're asking what a haiku is. It is a short poem of three lines with five, seven and five syllables. It often describes a moment in nature.
can i get my anser sheet recheked
You want to know if you can get your answer sheet rechecked. I don't know your board's rules. Ask your teacher or school office about the process and the last date.
hw to prepar for entrnce exam
You're asking how to prepare for an entrance exam. Get the syllabus, make a weekly plan, and solve old papers on time. Revise your mistakes in a notebook and keep a regular sleep routine.
wat is past tens of go
You want to know the past tense of go. It is went, as in, I went to school yesterday. The past participle is gone.
i wana join sports team how
You want to join the school sports team. Tell your sports teacher that you are interested and ask when the trials are. Practise regularly and come to the trial on time.
wat is the use of mircoscope
You want to know the use of a microscope. It makes very small things look big, like cells, tiny insects or pond water life. Scientists and students use it to see details the eye cannot.
how to type fastr on keybord
You're asking how to type faster on a keyboard. Learn where the keys are without looking, and place your fingers on the home row. Practise for ten minutes a day, and speed will come after accuracy.
I dont no wich stream to take is science ok

You're not sure which stream to take, and ask if science is okay. I can't decide that for you. Think about the subjects you enjoy, talk to your teachers and parents, and try a counselling session at school.
study wit ADHD how i can
You're asking how to study with ADHD. I can't give medical advice, so please talk to your doctor or a school counsellor. General habits like short study blocks and a quiet desk may help.
how write a speech for annul day
You want to write a speech for annual day. Start with a greeting, say a few warm words about the year, thank teachers and parents, and end with good wishes. Keep it under two minutes.
i need help in hindi grammer
You need help with Hindi grammar. I mostly help in English, so I can't teach this well. Please ask your Hindi teacher or use your textbook's exercises for practice.
be punctul in school hw
You want to learn how to be on time for school. Prepare your bag the night before, set an alarm a bit early, and leave home with a little spare time. Keep a daily routine.
wat if i miss exam due to illnes
You're asking what to do if you miss an exam because of illness. I don't know your school's rules. Tell your teacher or principal as soon as you can and ask about a re-exam.
how to find percentge of a number
You want to know how to find the percentage of a number. Change the percent to a fraction out of 100 and multiply. For example, 20 percent of 50 is 20/100 x 50, which is 10.
how can i rememer spellings
You're asking how to remember spellings. Split the word into small parts and say each part aloud. Write it three times from memory and test yourself again later.
what is mening of 'bored'
You want the meaning of bored. It means feeling tired because something is not interesting. For example, I felt bored during the long speech.
can music help in studing
You're asking if music can help in studying. For some people soft music without words helps focus, but loud songs can distract. Try both and see what works for you.
how to talk to princpal
You want to know how to talk to the principal. Ask for a time through the school office, greet respectfully, and say clearly what you want to discuss. Keep it short and polite.
how long does it take to get exam resalts
You're asking how long exam results take. I don't know the timing for your exam. Please check your school or board's official website or notice for the date.
wat is differnce betwen btech and bsc

You want the difference between BTech and BSc. BTech is an engineering degree, focused on building and applying technology. BSc is a science degree, focused more on theory and research. Check the college prospectus for details.
why we get rain bow
You want to know why a rainbow appears. Sunlight passes through raindrops, which split it into its colours. You see it when the sun is behind you and rain is in front.
how to leran a new language fast
You're asking how to learn a new language fast. Practise a little every day, learn common words first, and listen to people speak. Try speaking from the start, even with mistakes.
how many pages shud essay be
You're asking how many pages an essay should be. It depends on the assignment, so I don't know. Check your teacher's instructions for word count or pages.
y we wear uniform
You want to know why we wear uniforms. Uniforms make everyone look equal and help schools recognise students. They also save time in choosing clothes each morning.
can u tell wat is cut off for iit this yr
You're asking about this year's IIT cut-off. I can't see current numbers. Please check the official admissions website for the latest cut-off.
how to stop sleping while studing
You want to stop falling asleep while studying. Sit upright at a desk, keep the room bright, and take a short walk or splash water on your face. Study the hard topics when you are most alert.
how to read newspapr in english
You want to know how to read a newspaper in English. Start with the headlines and small stories. Underline new words, guess their meaning, and check the dictionary later.
how many paragrafs in a leter
You're asking how many paragraphs a letter needs. A short letter usually has three or four: an opening, one or two body paragraphs, and a closing.
wat is a triangel
You want to know what a triangle is. A triangle is a shape with three straight sides and three corners. Its three angles add up to 180 degrees.
if i get bullid wat to do
You're asking what to do if you are bullied. Tell a teacher or your parents right away, and stay near friends. You're not at fault, and adults at school can help.
how many mark for first class
You want to know how many marks make first class. It varies by board and university, so I don't know yours. Check the rules from your school or college.
how to use comma corectly
You want to know how to use a comma correctly. Use commas in a list, after an opening word like However, and before words like but in a long sentence. Don't use one to join two full sentences alone.
how to make time tabel
You're asking how to make a timetable. List your subjects and free hours, give more time to weak subjects, and add breaks. Keep it simple so you can follow it every day.
best age to lern piano
You're asking about the best age to learn piano. There is no fixed age. Many children begin around six or seven, but adults can start too. What matters is regular practice.
I got low marks in 12th now wat
You got low marks in twelfth and ask what to do now. I can't say what is best, but there are options like other courses, improvement exams or entrance tests. Meet a counsellor or teacher for advice.
how to scor good in english essay
You want to score well in an English essay. Plan with three or four points, write a clear opening and ending, and keep sentences simple. Check spelling and punctuation at the end.
is homework neccessary
You're asking if homework is necessary. Homework helps you practise what you learned in class. A small amount is useful, but too much can tire you.
how to remembr dates in history
You want to remember dates in history. Link each date to a story or event, and make a timeline on a chart. Say the key dates aloud and test yourself every week.
what is a thesis statment
You want to know what a thesis statement is. It is one sentence that gives the main idea of an essay. Everything else in the essay supports it.
sholud i study in group or alon
You're asking if you should study in a group or alone. Alone is best for learning new material. A group helps you test and explain things to each other. A mix of both works well.
wat is evaporashun
You want to know what evaporation is. It is when liquid water turns into vapour, usually because of heat. Wet clothes dry in the sun by evaporation.
do u know who made the quesion paper
You're asking who made the question paper. I don't know that. Exam papers are usually kept secret, so ask your school if you need to know.
how to improve spokan english in 1 mnth
You want to improve spoken English in one month. Speak for ten minutes daily, listen to simple talks, and repeat new phrases. A month brings progress, but not perfection, so keep going.
how to pack scool bag properley
You want to know how to pack a school bag properly. Put heavy books closest to your back, lighter items in front, and pack by timetable the night before. Keep a water bottle in a side pocket.
how to luv studyng
You want to learn to love studying. Pick topics that interest you, set small goals, and reward yourself after you finish. Connect lessons to real life, like cooking with fractions.
wats a sylabus
You want to know what a syllabus is. A syllabus is the list of topics you must study in a subject during the year. Teachers use it to plan lessons and set exams.
how can i cheak my own progres
You're asking how to check your own progress. Keep a record of your test marks and note topics you find hard. Every month, solve a short test and compare it with the last one.
wat is the capitl of australia
You want to know the capital of Australia. It is Canberra, not Sydney. Canberra was built as the capital city.
study maths well in 1 hr tel me how
You want to study maths well in one hour. Spend ten minutes revising formulas, forty minutes solving different problems, and ten minutes checking mistakes. Stop when the hour ends and rest.
wats the diff of 'since' n 'for'
You're asking the difference between since and for. Since gives a starting point, like since Monday. For gives a length of time, like for three days.
how shud i start lerning guitar
You want to start learning guitar. Learn how to hold it and tune it, then practise a few easy chords, like C and G. Short daily practice is better than one long session.
teacher keeps shouting wat to do
You're saying your teacher keeps shouting. I don't know the reason. Try to listen carefully and finish your work, and if it still upsets you, speak to your parents or another teacher.
how to prepar for oral exam
